symptom: An agent written with `create agent` / `create or modify agent` with a Description over 200 characters (or a name over 50) keeps its old behaviour at runtime: AgentEditorCommons' startup import fails with "tried setting a value of length 203" and Agent Commons keeps the previous version. check, exec and mx check are all clean.
file: mdl/executor/validate_agent_commons_lengths.go (MDL-AGENT04), wired in validate_program.go. Test: validate_agent_commons_lengths_test.go TestValidateAgentCommonsLengths
cause: AgentFromModel_CreateUpdateAgent copies the document into AgentCommons.Agent.Title String(50), Agent.Description String(200), Tool.Name / DisplayTitle String(200), Tool.Description String(4096) (Agent Editor 2.7.0, Mendix 11.16). Nothing in mxcli or mxbuild knew those lengths.
insight: **A value copied into an entity at startup inherits that attribute's length.** The agent document is free-form JSON with no limits, so the constraint lives in the importer's target domain model, not the document; read the String lengths of the entities the import microflow writes. Count runes: a 200-character Description in two-byte letters is 400 bytes and fits. Controls: a stub returning nothing fails every positive case, and counting bytes instead of runes flags the 200-character multi-byte Description.
